title: Paralokame Naa Swasthyamu – Hadlee Xavier Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: పరమ మకుటము పొందను – ప్రభు పాదముల చేరెదను
ప్రభు యేసు మహిమ కొరకు – గురి గలిగి జీవింతును
3. నా పరుగు తుదముట్టింప – నాకు కృపను మెండుగ నొసగును
పగలు రాత్రచ్చట లేదు – ప్రభువే దీపమై యుండును
5. ప్రియుని పిలుపును విని – నేను కూడా సిద్ధపడెదను
english: Naa priya Yesuni – nen eppudu gaanthuno
1. Aakali dhappulu dhuhkhamu – manovedhana ledhu achchata
Parama makutamu pondanu – Prabhu paadamula cheredanu
2. Siluva veyabadithini – ika ne kaadhu jeevinchuta
Prabhu Yesu mahima koraku – guri galigi jeevinthunu
3. Naa parugu thudhamuttimpa – naaku krupanu menduga nosagunu
Pagalu raathri achchata ledhu – Prabhuve dheepamai undunu
5. Priyuni pilupunu vini – nenu kooda siddhapadedhanu
translation: Heaven is my inheritance—
When will I reach there?
When will I see
My beloved Jesus?
1. There will be no hunger, thirst, sorrow,
Or mental pain there.
I will receive the heavenly crown
And reach the feet of the Lord.
2. I have been crucified (with Christ),
Now it is no longer I who live.
For the glory of Lord Jesus,
I will live with a clear purpose.
3. To finish my race,
He will give me abundant grace.
On the path of faith,
I will run without growing weary.
4. I will receive eternal rest
And enter heaven.
There is no day or night there—
The Lord Himself is the light.
5. Hearing the call of my beloved,
I will also be ready.
As the days draw near,
My longing increases more and more.
intro: Paralokame Naa Swasthyamu is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Kurian G S and music composed & sung by Hadlee Xavier. This song was released on March 25, 2026, through Hadlee Xavier YouTube Channel.
